meta.title: [English (auto-generated)] President Xi greets Trump and Putin at start of historic summit in China  BBC News [DownSub.com]

material.title_suggested: [English (auto-generated)] President Xi greets Trump and Putin at start of historic summit in China  BBC News [DownSub.com]
material.advice: This material contains long sentences with multiple clauses and some tricky proper nouns (e.g., 'Laura Bicker', 'Steve Rosenberg', 'APEC'). Pay attention to the parallel structures and transitions between speakers. For recitation, use the hint keywords as memory anchors for each chunk, and practice chunking long sentences into smaller breath groups (e.g., chunk 17 can be split into two parts: the pitfalls and the Ukraine example).

chunks.text: President Putin, President Trump, and President Xi Jinping will sit down together for their first ever face-to-face talks together.
chunks.translation: 普京总统、特朗普总统和习近平主席将首次面对面坐在一起会谈。

chunks.text: The hour-long meeting is being held in the Chinese city of Shenzhen at the APEC economic summit.
chunks.translation: 这场长达一小时的会议在中国城市深圳的亚太经合组织经济峰会上举行。

chunks.text: Here's our China correspondent, Laura Bicker. The arrival of President Xi's motorcade was the first hint. This was going to be no ordinary welcome.
chunks.translation: 本台中国记者劳拉·比克报道。习近平主席车队的抵达是第一个暗示。这将不是一次普通的欢迎。

chunks.text: As the children chanted and waved, Mr. Trump reveled in his big arrival. And then there was even a hug. This was a carefully choreographed gesture designed to flatter the US president.
chunks.translation: 当孩子们欢呼挥手时，特朗普先生陶醉于他的盛大登场。然后甚至还有一个拥抱。这是一个精心设计的姿态，旨在奉承美国总统。

chunks.text: The first time as leader that Mr. Shei has greeted a guest at the airport. A calculated display of warmth ahead of difficult conversations on trade, Taiwan, and technology.
chunks.translation: 这是习先生作为领导人首次在机场迎接客人。在关于贸易、台湾和技术的艰难对话之前，这是一种精心计算的热情展示。

chunks.text: >> The Chinese leader has already met his other guest of honor. >> Both address each other as old friend. After all, this is their 50th meeting.
chunks.translation: >> 中国领导人已经会见了他的另一位贵宾。>> 两人互称老朋友。毕竟，这是他们的第50次会晤。

chunks.text: China Russia relations are as solid as a mountain, he said, undaunted by wind and drain, creating greater stability in a rapidly changing world.
chunks.translation: 他说，中俄关系坚如磐石，不受风雨侵蚀，在快速变化的世界中创造更大的稳定。

chunks.text: >> The two had lunch, perhaps discussing their shared goal to challenge American dominance on the world stage. >> You're also very friendly.
chunks.translation: >> 两人共进午餐，或许讨论了他们在世界舞台上挑战美国主导地位的共同目标。>> 你也很友好。

chunks.text: >> Among curious crowds, there's a realization that this city is on the cusp of an unprecedented summit. >> This is new for Shenzhen. How does it feel having all these wed leaders come here? >> I feel very excited.
chunks.translation: >> 在好奇的人群中，人们意识到这座城市正处于一场前所未有的峰会的风口浪尖。>> 这对深圳来说是新的。所有这些领导人来到这里感觉如何？>> 我感到非常兴奋。

chunks.text: >> There are certainly conflicts between our country and the United States. But by working together, we can discuss matters and give everyone a bigger slice of the pie.
chunks.translation: >> 我们国家和美国之间确实存在冲突。但通过合作，我们可以讨论问题，给每个人更大的一块蛋糕。

chunks.text: We can talk through some of our differences. You give in a little, I give in a little. Then things will be easier to resolve, won't they?
chunks.translation: 我们可以通过对话解决一些分歧。你让步一点，我让步一点。那么事情就会更容易解决，不是吗？

chunks.text: This is what happens when the three most powerful men come to town. Security has really ramped up here in the city of 18 million people ahead of that historic trilateral summit.
chunks.translation: 这就是三位最有权势的人来到镇上时会发生的事情。在这场历史性的三边峰会之前，这座拥有1800万人口的城市的安全措施确实加强了。

chunks.text: >> At the gala dinner, there was a glimpse of what lies ahead. China, the US, and Russia all together. But it's still unclear what they're going to talk about.
chunks.translation: >> 在晚宴上，可以一窥未来的情况。中国、美国和俄罗斯齐聚一堂。但目前仍不清楚他们将谈论什么。

chunks.text: all have differing views on Ukraine, the war in Iran, and nuclear weapons. They can get into position for the cameras, but these are three leaders with three different agendas and little guarantee of any substantive outcome.
chunks.translation: 三方在乌克兰、伊朗战争和核武器问题上观点各异。他们可以为镜头摆好姿势，但这是三位有着不同议程的领导人，几乎不能保证取得任何实质性成果。

chunks.text: >> Well, let's go live now to Laura in Shenzhen. She's joined there by our Russia editor, Steve Rosenberg. 6:00 in the morning there for you. A very big day ahead.
chunks.translation: >> 好的，现在让我们连线在深圳的劳拉。我们的俄罗斯编辑史蒂夫·罗森伯格也在那里。那里现在是早上6点。前方是非常重要的一天。

chunks.text: Laura, first, what is President Xi hoping to get from these talks? Well, first of all, for him it's a big diplomatic moment. He can exude power and prestige and the Chinese believe that he is the only leader that could bring these world powers together.
chunks.translation: 劳拉，首先，习近平主席希望从这些会谈中得到什么？嗯，首先，对他来说这是一个重大的外交时刻。他可以展现权力和威望，中国人认为他是唯一能够将这些世界大国聚集在一起的领导人。

chunks.text: But it isn't without its pitfalls for President Xi and that is because China has many subjects that it doesn't want to talk about. First of all, when it comes to the Ukraine war, President Xi doesn't want all three leaders discussing that war without the EU in the room because it believes perhaps it may already risk a rocky relationship with Europe.
chunks.translation: 但对习近平主席来说，这并非没有陷阱，这是因为中国有许多不想谈论的话题。首先，在乌克兰战争问题上，习近平主席不希望三位领导人没有欧盟在场就讨论那场战争，因为它认为这可能已经危及与欧洲的脆弱关系。

chunks.text: And then it comes down to arms control. Certainly, Mr. Trump wants to talk about nuclear weapons. President Xi does not. He doesn't want to be bound by any treaty that could restrict China's rise as a nuclear power.
chunks.translation: 然后就是军备控制。当然，特朗普先生想谈论核武器。习近平主席不想。他不想受到任何可能限制中国作为核大国崛起的条约的约束。

chunks.text: And then of course there's the potential of an unscripted moment between two unpredictable leaders. But again that could play to President Xi's advantage in comparison. He looks like this stable global leader. And when it comes to the two men beside him, they are at war that they simply cannot end.
chunks.translation: 当然，还有两位不可预测的领导人之间可能出现即兴时刻的可能性。但相比之下，这又可能对习近平主席有利。他看起来像这位稳定的全球领导人。而在他身边的两个人，他们正处于一场他们根本无法结束的战争中。

chunks.text: When it comes to President Xi, this is the culmination of a diplomatic dream for his country. A China not just shaped by world events, but a China with a leader on the helm trying to shape a new world order, one not led by the United States.
chunks.translation: 对习近平主席来说，这是他国家外交梦想的顶峰。一个不仅被世界事件塑造的中国，而且是一个有领导人掌舵试图塑造新世界秩序的中国，一个不是由美国领导的世界秩序。

chunks.text: >> And Steve Rosenberg, what about President Putin? What will he be hoping to come away with from this? >> Well, I think for Vladimir Putin, this meeting is less about the substance and more about the symbolism. the fact that uh he is going to be sitting down uh with the leaders of the two great powers, China and America.
chunks.translation: >> 史蒂夫·罗森伯格，那普京总统呢？他希望从中得到什么？>> 嗯，我认为对弗拉基米尔·普京来说，这次会议与其说是实质内容，不如说是象征意义。事实上，他将与中国和美国这两个大国的领导人坐在一起。

chunks.text: Um this is being presented already by Moscow as a diplomatic victory for Moscow. And you can kind of understand why because you know go back to 2022 he was an international pariah after the full-scale Russian invasion of Ukraine.
chunks.translation: 嗯，莫斯科已经将此视为莫斯科的外交胜利。你可以理解为什么，因为你知道回到2022年，在俄罗斯全面入侵乌克兰后，他是一个国际弃儿。

chunks.text: Now he can present himself as a global statesman at the top table of geopolitics, one of the big three and Moscow, I'm sure, is going to make the most of the optics here.
chunks.translation: 现在他可以把自己展示为全球政治家，在地缘政治的最高桌旁，三大国之一，我相信莫斯科会充分利用这里的视觉效果。

chunks.text: Having said that, the Kremlin has said that this meeting will last an hour. Now, as many summits go, that is particularly mini, although I suppose it it could last longer.
chunks.translation: 话虽如此，克里姆林宫表示这次会议将持续一个小时。现在，正如许多峰会一样，这特别简短，尽管我想它可能会持续更长时间。

chunks.text: The other thing is that even if uh Vladimir Putin claims a diplomatic victory, when he goes home, he has the problem of trying to secure what has remained elusive for nearly 5 years, a military victory in Russia's war on Ukraine.
chunks.translation: 另一件事是，即使弗拉基米尔·普京声称外交胜利，当他回国时，他还有问题要努力确保近5年来一直难以实现的东西，即在俄罗斯对乌克兰的战争中取得军事胜利。

chunks.text: And it's not clear whether this meeting is going to bring that victory uh any closer. Um the other thing is though that in Ukraine they will be nervous wondering what kind of conversations will be taking place about Ukraine without Ukraine at the table.
chunks.translation: 目前还不清楚这次会议是否会让那场胜利更近一步。嗯，另一件事是，在乌克兰，他们会感到紧张，想知道在没有乌克兰在场的情况下，关于乌克兰的对话会是什么样的。

chunks.text: Not only with the trilateral meeting between the three leaders, but the bilateral meeting between Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin.
chunks.translation: 不仅是三位领导人之间的三边会议，还有唐纳德·特朗普和弗拉基米尔·普京之间的双边会议。
